P.name: Get Excited!
P.title: Template:Data Jinx/Get Excited!
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Get Excited!|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jinx
|skill        = I
|icon         = Get Excited!.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever {{ci|Jinx}} scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, {{tip|turret}}, or [[inhibitor]] shortly after damaging them, she gains a burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} for a few seconds.
|blurb2       = During this time, she also gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus total''' attack speed}}}} and is allowed to exceed the attack speed cap.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Jinx''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, {{tip|turret}}, or [[inhibitor]] within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|175% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 6 seconds.
|description2 = Additionally, she is allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}} and gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Get Excited!'' for the same duration, stacking up to 5 times. Only {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can grant stacks beyond the first.
|description3 = {{sbc|Get Excited!:}} For each stack, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|{{as|25% '''total''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{ap|25*5}}%|as}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self 
|notes        =
* '''Jinx's''' ''attack speed cap'' is increased to {{fd|90.0}} for the duration, however this value is already beyond the technical limit for attack speed.
* '''Jinx''' will still trigger ''Get Excited'' from killing a summoned {{ui|Rift Herald}}.
* '''Jinx''' will fail to trigger ''Get Excited'' in the specific circumstance of killing {{ui|Baron Nashor}} while more than ~2500 distance away.{{bug}}
|yvideo       = 9kf-S9TIo88
}}

E.name: Flame Chompers!
E.title: Template:Data Jinx/Flame Chompers!
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Flame Chompers!|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jinx
|skill        = E
|icon         = Flame Chompers!.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jinx}} tosses a line of ''Chompers'' at the target location that explode after a few seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
|blurb2       = If an enemy champion steps on a ''Chomper'', it will explode, {{tip|knockdown|knock them down}}, and briefly {{tip|root}} them.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' tosses out 3 ''Chompers'' centered at the target location, landing after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
|leveling    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|90 to 290}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
|icon2        = Flame Chompers! 2.png
|description2 = Each ''Chomper'' explodes on contact with an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one ''Chomper''.
|target range = 925
|collision radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|115|Detection radius}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|225|Damage radius}}
|cost         = 90
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|24 to 10}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|cast time = none
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = Special
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* ''Chompers'' will halt when encountering {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not negate the explosion.
* Each ''Chomper'' gives vision of its surrounding area.
|yvideo       = rCH7MMve8gE
}}
